title_en: Provisions of the State Council on the Simultaneous Hoisting and Use of the National Flag and Regional Flag in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

articles.content_en: 1. When the national flag and the regional flag are hoisted and used at the same time, the national flag shall be placed in the center, a higher, or a prominent position.

2. When the national flag and the regional flag are hoisted and used simultaneously or side by side, the national flag shall be larger than the regional flag, with the national flag on the right and the regional flag on the left.
3. When marching in a formation holding the national flag and the regional flag, the national flag shall be in front of the regional flag.
